## Services

- [Power washing](https://www.example.com/services/power-washing/): Driveways, siding, decks and fences, washed back to their real color. Typical price $90 to $500.
- [Junk removal](https://www.example.com/services/junk-removal/): Garages, attics and yards cleared out, loaded and hauled the same visit. Typical price $75 to $550.
- [Car detailing](https://www.example.com/services/car-detailing/): Interior and exterior detailing in your driveway. No drop-off, no waiting room. Typical price $110 to $260.
